name: com.forexdemo/forexdemo
title: ForexDemo.com
description: Forex, gold and futures trading calculators and Forex demo account research at 59 brokers.

tools.name: calculate_pip
tools.description: What one pip is worth in the account currency for a Forex pair or gold at a given trade size, and optionally the profit or loss of a move in pips. Same calculation as the Pip Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/pip-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

pair.description: Currency pair or gold (XAU/USD). EURUSD and eur-usd are accepted too.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

sizeUnit.description: How the size is given: standard (100,000 units), mini (10,000), micro (1,000), nano (100) lots, or units.

rate.description: Only needed when the account currency is not in the pair: the price of the market pair that converts it (for example the GBP/USD price for EUR/GBP in a USD account). Leave it out to use the example price shown on the page.

pipsMoved.description: Optional price move to value. Negative for a loss.

moveUnit.description: Unit of pipsMoved: pips, points (MetaTrader, 10 points = 1 pip) or, for gold only, dollars an ounce.

goldPip.description: Gold only: the price change your broker calls one pip.

tools.name: calculate_position_size
tools.description: How many lots to trade so that hitting the stop-loss loses a set percentage or amount of the account. Same calculation as the Position Size Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/position-size-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

pair.description: Currency pair, such as EUR/USD. EURUSD and eur-usd are accepted too.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

balance.description: Account balance in the account currency. Needed when riskMode is percent.

riskMode.description: percent: risk is a percentage of the balance. money: risk is an amount in the account currency.

risk.description: Risk per trade: a percentage (1 for 1%) or an amount, per riskMode.

stopMode.description: pips: give the stop distance in stopPips. prices: give the entry and stop prices.

stopUnit.description: Unit of stopPips: pips or points (10 points = 1 pip).

price.description: Optional pair price, for the position value. Leave it out to use the example price.

rate.description: Only needed when the account currency is not in the pair: the price of the market pair that converts it (for example the GBP/USD price for EUR/GBP in a USD account). Required when the account currency is not in the pair.

spread.description: Optional spread to add to the stop distance, in costUnit (buys only, as on the page).

slippage.description: Optional stop slippage allowance, in costUnit.

commission.description: Optional commission per standard lot, in the account currency.

commissionBasis.description: side: charged when opening and again when closing. round: once per round trip.

lotStep.description: The smallest size step your broker allows.

tools.name: calculate_profit
tools.description: Profit or loss of one Forex or gold trade from its open and close prices, in pips and in the account currency, before and after spread, commission and swap. Same calculation as the Forex Profit Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/forex-profit-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

pair.description: Currency pair or gold (XAU/USD). EURUSD and eur-usd are accepted too.

sizeUnit.description: How the size is given: standard (100,000 units), mini (10,000), micro (1,000), nano (100) lots, or units.

close.description: Close price, or the price you expect.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

rate.description: Only needed when the account currency is not in the pair: the price of the market pair that converts it (for example the GBP/USD price for EUR/GBP in a USD account). Required when neither currency of the pair is the account currency.

spreadUnit.description: Unit of spread: pips, or points as MetaTrader shows it.

commission.description: Optional commission per standard lot, in the account currency.

commissionBasis.description: side: charged when opening and again when closing. round: once per round trip.

swap.description: Optional overnight swap for all nights held, in the account currency. A charge has a minus sign, such as -12.50.

balance.description: Optional account balance, to show the result as a percentage.

tools.name: calculate_compounding
tools.description: How an account grows when the same percentage gain is made every trade, day, week, month or year, with optional deposits, withdrawals and losing periods. Same calculation as the Forex Compounding Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/forex-compounding-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

gain.description: Gain per period in percent. Negative for a loss. Give 2 for 2%.

period.description: How often the gain is made.

flowType.description: Optional regular money in or out: deposit, withdraw (an amount) or share (a percentage of the profit).

flow.description: Amount (or percentage for share) of each deposit or withdrawal.

flowEvery.description: How many periods between deposits or withdrawals. Defaults to about once a month.

lossCount.description: Not for period trade: how many losing periods in each group of lossEvery.

lossEvery.description: Not for period trade: the size of the group, such as 1 loss every 4 months.

winRate.description: Only for period trade: the share of trades that win. Give 2 for 2%.

lossPercent.description: The percentage lost in each losing period or losing trade. Give 2 for 2%.

tools.name: calculate_margin
tools.description: Margin needed to open a Forex or gold trade at a given leverage or margin percentage, and, with a balance, the free margin, margin level and the prices of the margin call and stop out. Same calculation as the Margin and Leverage Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/forex-margin-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

pair.description: Currency pair or gold (XAU/USD). EURUSD and eur-usd are accepted too.

sizeUnit.description: How the size is given: standard (100,000 units), mini (10,000), micro (1,000), nano (100) lots, or units.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

price.description: Pair price when the trade opens. Leave it out to use the example price.

rate.description: Only needed when the account currency is not in the pair: the price of the market pair that converts it (for example the GBP/USD price for EUR/GBP in a USD account). Leave it out to use the example price.

marginMode.description: leverage: give leverage. percent: give the margin requirement as a percentage.

marginPercent.description: Margin requirement in percent (marginMode percent). Give 2 for 2%.

balance.description: Optional account balance, for free margin, margin level and margin call prices.

tools.name: calculate_drawdown
tools.description: What a run of losing trades does to an account, the gain needed to win it back, how likely such a run is, and the chance of reaching a drawdown limit. Same calculation as the Forex Drawdown Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/forex-drawdown-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

risk.description: Risk per trade in percent. Give 2 for 2%.

riskBase.description: current: risk is a share of the current balance. start: of the starting balance.

winRate.description: Win rate in percent, for the chance of a losing run. Give 2 for 2%.

reward.description: Average win as a multiple of the risk, such as 1.5.

trades.description: Number of trades to look ahead.

limit.description: Drawdown limit in percent, such as a prop firm's. Give 2 for 2%.

limitType.description: Where the limit is measured from: peak (highest balance), start (starting balance) or lock (trailing until it locks at the start).

tools.name: calculate_risk_reward
tools.description: Risk-reward ratio of a trade from its entry, stop-loss and take-profit, the win rate at which trades of that shape break even, and the likely result over many trades. Same calculation as the Risk Reward Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/risk-reward-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

mode.description: prices: give entry, stop and target prices. distance: give stopDistance and targetDistance.

pair.description: Pair, used for pip size in prices mode. EURUSD and eur-usd are accepted too.

entry.description: Entry price (mode prices). Leave all three prices out to use the example trade.

spread.description: Optional spread, in pips (prices mode) or the distance unit.

riskAmount.description: Optional amount risked per trade, in the account currency.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

winRate.description: Win rate in percent, for the result over many trades. Give 2 for 2%.

trades.description: Number of trades for the result over many trades.

tools.name: calculate_account_survival
tools.description: The chance that a trading account loses a set share of its money (risk of ruin) within a number of trades, from the win rate, the average win and the risk per trade. Same calculation as the Account Survival Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/account-survival-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

winRate.description: Win rate in percent. Give 2 for 2%.

reward.description: Average win as a multiple of the risk, such as 1.5.

trades.description: Number of trades to look ahead.

risk.description: Risk per trade in percent. Give 2 for 2%.

riskBase.description: current: risk is a share of the current balance. start: of the starting balance.

ruin.description: Ruin level: the share of the account lost that counts as ruin. Give 2 for 2%.

ruinType.description: Where the ruin level is measured from: start or peak.

target.description: Optional profit target in percent. Give 2 for 2%.

tools.name: calculate_kelly
tools.description: The share of an account to risk on each trade that grows it fastest over many trades (the Kelly criterion), half and quarter Kelly, and what a chosen risk gives. Same calculation as the Kelly Criterion Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/kelly-criterion-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

winRate.description: Win rate in percent. Give 2 for 2%.

reward.description: Average win as a multiple of the average loss, such as 1.5.

trades.description: Number of trades to look ahead.

risk.description: Risk per trade in percent, to compare with Kelly. Give 2 for 2%.

sample.description: Optional: how many past trades the win rate comes from, to show how sure it is.

balance.description: Optional account balance, to show amounts.

tools.name: calculate_win_rate
tools.description: Win rate from the number of winning and losing trades, how sure that win rate is, and, with the average win and loss, the break-even win rate, profit factor and expectancy. Same calculation as the Win Rate Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/win-rate-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

averageLoss.description: Optional average loss, in money, without a minus sign.

cost.description: Optional cost per trade (spread and commission), in money.

target.description: Optional win rate to reach, in percent. Give 2 for 2%.

tools.name: calculate_swap
tools.description: Overnight swap (rollover) cost or credit of holding a Forex position, night by night including the triple day, from the swap rates a platform shows. Same calculation as the Forex Swap Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/forex-swap-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

pair.description: Currency pair, such as EUR/USD. EURUSD and eur-usd are accepted too.

long.description: Swap long (for buys), exactly as the platform shows it, in swapUnit. A charge has a minus sign, such as -9.17.

short.description: Swap short (for sells), exactly as the platform shows it, in swapUnit.

swapUnit.description: The unit the platform shows the swap in: points (MetaTrader), pips, percent a year, or money per standard lot per night.

precision.description: Only for points: fractional when prices have 5 decimals (3 for yen pairs), whole when they have 4 (2 for yen pairs).

amountCurrency.description: Only for money: the currency the swap amounts are in.

yearBasis.description: Only for percent: the number of days in the broker's interest year.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

price.description: Pair price. Needed for percent swaps, base-currency money swaps, and when the account currency is the pair's first currency.

rate.description: Only needed when the account currency is not in the pair: the price of the market pair that converts it (for example the GBP/USD price for EUR/GBP in a USD account). Required when neither currency of the pair is the account currency.

tripleDay.description: The night that counts three days of interest. Usually Wednesday (Thursday for USD/CAD at some brokers).

balance.description: Optional account balance, for effective leverage.

tools.name: calculate_yen_carry
tools.description: What a carry trade earns or pays in swap over a holding period, its yearly carry yield, how far the price can move against it before the swap is used up, and what a sharp unwind like 2024 would cost. Same calculation as the Yen Carry Trade Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/yen-carry-trade-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

pair.description: Currency pair. The yen pairs are the classic carry trades; the other pairs work too.

currency.description: The currency the trading account is held in.

rate.description: Only needed when the account currency is not in the pair: the price of the market pair that converts it (for example the GBP/USD price for EUR/GBP in a USD account). Required when the account currency is not in the pair.

long.description: Swap long (for buys), exactly as the platform shows it, in swapUnit. A charge has a minus sign, such as -9.17.

short.description: Swap short (for sells), exactly as the platform shows it, in swapUnit.

swapUnit.description: The unit the platform shows the swap in: points (MetaTrader), pips, percent a year, or money per standard lot per night.

precision.description: Only for points: fractional when prices have 5 decimals (3 for yen pairs), whole when they have 4 (2 for yen pairs).

amountCurrency.description: Only for money: the currency the swap amounts are in.

yearBasis.description: Only for percent: the number of days in the broker's interest year.

tripleDay.description: The night that counts three days of interest.

tools.name: calculate_slippage
tools.description: What slippage (the difference between the price asked for and the price filled) costs per trade, per month and over a period. Same calculation as the Forex Slippage Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/forex-slippage-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

pair.description: Currency pair, such as EUR/USD. EURUSD and eur-usd are accepted too.

size.description: Average size per trade, in sizeUnit.

entry.description: Slippage on entry per trade, in slippageUnit.

exit.description: Slippage on exit per trade, in slippageUnit.

precision.description: Only for points: fractional when prices have 5 decimals (3 for yen pairs), whole when they have 4 (2 for yen pairs).

currency.description: Currency to show costs in: quote (the pair's second currency) or another currency.

rate.description: Only needed when the account currency is not in the pair: the price of the market pair that converts it (for example the GBP/USD price for EUR/GBP in a USD account). Required when currency is not quote.

stopPips.description: Optional stop distance in pips, to compare the slippage with the risk.

averageWinPips.description: Optional average win in pips, to compare the slippage with the average win.

tools.name: calculate_futures
tools.description: Tick value, the value of a one-point move and the profit or loss of a trade for CME Group futures such as ES, MES, NQ, MNQ, CL, GC and 6E. Same calculation as the Futures Calculator page at https://forexdemo.com/futures-calculator.html. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

contract.description: Contract symbol, or custom with tickSize and tickValue.

tickValue.description: Custom contract only: tick value in US dollars.

mode.description: prices: profit or loss from entry and exit prices. move: value of a move. dollars: the move that makes a dollar amount.

moveUnit.description: Unit of moveSize: move (the contract's own point, pip or dollar step) or ticks.

fee.description: Optional fee per contract, in US dollars.

tools.name: calculate_futures_contracts
tools.description: How many futures contracts fit the amount a trader is willing to lose at the stop, with the micro contract as a finer alternative. Same calculation as the Futures Calculator: how many contracts page at https://forexdemo.com/futures-calculator.html#how-many-contracts. Every input is optional unless marked required; left-out inputs use the page's defaults, which are listed in the reply.

risk.description: The most you are willing to lose on the trade, in US dollars.

stopUnit.description: How the stop is given: move (the contract's own point, pip or dollar step), ticks, or prices (sizeEntry and sizeStopPrice).

stopDistance.description: Distance to the stop, in stopUnit (move or ticks).

sizeFee.description: Optional fee per contract, in US dollars.

tools.name: find_demo_accounts
tools.description: Search ForexDemo.com's research on Forex demo accounts at 59 brokers by broker, platform, the country of the broker company and how long the demo lasts. Returns each demo's time limit, starting virtual money, the date it was checked, the broker's demo sign-up page and the ForexDemo.com page.

broker.description: Broker name or part of it, such as "IG", "OANDA" or "FOREX.com". Leave out for every broker.

platform.description: Trading platform: mt4 (MetaTrader 4), mt5 (MetaTrader 5), ctrader, tradingview, web (the broker's own platform or app), jforex, ticktrader, tws (Interactive Brokers) or rstockstrader.

region.description: Country of the broker company that provides the demo, as a name or code, such as "United States", "US", "UK" or "Australia". This is where the company is licensed, not a list of countries it accepts.

timeLimit.description: none: demos with no time limit. fixed: demos that close a set number of days after opening. active: demos that stay open while you keep logging in or trading. unknown: the broker does not say.

limit.description: How many demo accounts to return, 1 to 25.

tools.name: get_demo_account
tools.description: Full ForexDemo.com research for one demo account, by the id from find_demo_accounts: the company that provides it, how long it lasts, the virtual money, the date checked, the sign-up page and the broker's own pages the facts come from.

id.description: The demo account id from find_demo_accounts, such as "oanda-mt4-us".

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ForexDemo.com's calculators, brokers and demo account research by keywords. Returns up to 10 results, each with an id for fetch, a title and the ForexDemo.com address.

query.description: Words to search for, such as "pip value", "swap" or "OANDA demo".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one ForexDemo.com search result in full by its id from search: a calculator with its inputs and a worked example, a broker with all its researched demo accounts, or one demo account.

id.description: An id from search, such as "calculator:pip", "broker:oanda" or "demo:oanda-mt4-us".
